title: GitHub

hostname.label: GitHub hostname
hostname.help: Hostname only, for example github.com or gitlab.example.com. No https:// prefix, path or port. Host login must match this hostname.

help: Provides gh CLI/API access for pull requests, issues and GitHub repositories. SSH is independent.
On the host: gh auth login --hostname github.com (use your hostname for Enterprise).
Alternatively provide GH_TOKEN to the launching process; Enterprise uses GH_ENTERPRISE_TOKEN. Never save token values in JSON.
Check login yourself on the host: gh auth status --hostname github.com.
For an SSH Git remote, also enable the SSH plugin and add the public key to your GitHub account.
